description.value: The Tides Cottages is a 3-acre oceanfront resort on Pender Island in the Southern Gulf Islands, operating on a site that has been continuously run as a resort since 1942 and is billed as the longest-standing resort in the region. The property features a heritage house dating to 1928, four individual cottages with private decks and ocean views, a seasonal pool and year-round hot tub. Touring cyclists reaching Pender Island by ferry will find self-contained cottage units with kitchens or kitchenettes — a practical base for island exploration.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides rich detail about the property, amenities, and contact info. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, drying areas, e-bike charging, or any cycling-specific facilities anywhere on the site. Wi-Fi is explicitly confirmed as a listed amenity ('Free Wifi'). The contact page reveals a phone number (604-365-2116) not present in OSM; address matches OSM.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; website contact page lists 604-365-2116 — phone added from website, contact_confirmed.phone set to null as there was no OSM value to corroborate against.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating oceanfront cottage resort on Pender Island with an active booking system and confirmed open status. Useful base for cycling tourists accessing the Southern Gulf Islands by ferry.
